pk.context: 0.75 mg subcutaneous, steady state, healthy adults

pill.desc: clear, colorless solution in a single-dose pen

tell: Fused to a modified IgG4 Fc chain, its roughly five-day elimination half-life sets it apart.

clues.text: Absolute subcutaneous bioavailability is 65% for 0.75 mg and 47% for 1.5 mg. The molecule is presumed to be broken down into amino acids by general protein catabolism.
Made by mammalian cell culture in Chinese hamster ovary cells, with an overall molecular weight of about 63 kilodaltons.
Approved under a BLA in single-dose pens, dosed once weekly.

Boxed warning for thyroid C-cell tumors. Contraindicated with a personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma, MEN 2, or serious hypersensitivity; anaphylaxis and angioedema have been reported.
Glycemic control in type 2 diabetes for adults and patients 10 years and older, and reducing major cardiovascular events in adults with established disease.
Activates the GLP-1 receptor, raising cAMP in beta cells for glucose-dependent insulin release, and also slows gastric emptying.
The generic name begins with D and has eleven letters.
